job.title: Senior Backend Engineer II - IPC
job.location: Remote or Hybrid (Hiring Remotely in US)
job.description: Design, build, and operate backend services for Bestow’s insurance platform using Python, Go, Java, and PostgreSQL. Collaborate on technical decisions, integrations, carrier onboarding, and scalable platform capabilities. Mentor engineers through reviews and pairing, improve production reliability and observability, participate in on-call support, and communicate technical decisions in a remote-first environment. Use agentic AI coding tools daily and help establish effective AI-assisted development practices.
responsibilities: Contribute to technical design decisions for IPC services, balancing delivery speed with long-term maintainability
Design, build, and operate backend services using Python, PostgreSQL, Go, and Java-based Drools rules engine
Partner with other Bestow engineering teams on integration work across platform
Help build platform capabilities that scale with Bestow's growing partner ecosystem
Mentor engineers through code review, design review, and pairing
Support production reliability: help maintain/improve SLOs, strengthen observability, share on-call for IPC workloads
Use agentic AI coding tools as core part of workflow, help team adopt effective AI-assisted development practices
Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and status clearly in writing
